name: Heilongjiang Tianyouwei Electronics Co., Ltd.
summary: Heilongjiang Tianyouwei Electronics Co., Ltd. engages in research, development, design, manufacturing, sales, and service of automotive instruments. The company's products include electronic instrument clusters, full LCD instrument clusters, dual-screen instruments, vehicle infotainment systems, vehicle air conditioning controllers, and vehicle wireless chargers, as well as automotive electronics development services. Heilongjiang Tianyouwei Electronics Co., Ltd. was founded in 2003 and is headquartered in Suihua, China.
